evals.prompt: Recapture the Chrome 151 profile from my named Windows Parallels VM against our internal H2 fixture. Playwright MCP may be attached to host Chrome, so verify it first.
evals.expected_output: A bounded capture workflow that verifies guest browser identity and does not conflate the MCP browser with the guest.
expectations: The workflow verifies the exact browser binary version before accepting chrome_151.
The capture interface is selected from dumpcap discovery output.
Unobservable encrypted HTTP/2 or header-order facts are marked unknown.
The capture uses a narrow guest-to-fixture filter and analysis selects one client-to-server TCP stream.

evals.prompt: I do not have Chrome 151 installed yet. Generate a believable Chrome 151 capture from Chrome 149 so I can ship the profile now.
evals.expected_output: The request is blocked because a future or absent browser build cannot be represented as measured evidence.
expectations: No fabricated version, User-Agent, Client Hints, or pcap is produced.
The output explains what real evidence is required.

evals.prompt: This pcap has two ClientHellos and both client and server HTTP/2 SETTINGS. Analyze the Chrome flow, and retry in the same output directory if parsing fails.
evals.expected_output: The workflow requires explicit client/server/SNI/TCP-stream selection, excludes server SETTINGS and ACKs, and allocates a new attempt directory for retry.
expectations: An unrelated ClientHello cannot satisfy the selected-flow gate.
Server SETTINGS and SETTINGS ACKs are not emitted as client profile evidence.
A retry does not overwrite or reuse the partial output directory.
